title: utils¶
content:
utils¶

Utilities for working with mobjects.

Functions

get_mobject_class()[source]¶

Gets the base mobject class, depending on the currently active renderer.NoteThis method is intended to be used in the code base of Manim itself
or in plugins where code should work independent of the selected
renderer.ExamplesThe function has to be explicitly imported. We test that
the name of the returned class is one of the known mobject
base classes:>>>frommanim.mobject.utilsimportget_mobject_class>>>get_mobject_class().__name__in['Mobject','OpenGLMobject']TrueReturn type:type
